tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Cities that have upcoming comedy shows, with the slug to pass to find_shows and the count.

tools.name: find_shows
tools.description: Upcoming stand-up / comedy shows. Filter by city slug (from list_cities), a window (today, weekend, upcoming = next 60 days) or an explicit date_from/date_to (YYYY-MM-DD, max 92 days), and optionally a venue slug. Dates are Mexico City time.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search by name across upcoming shows (next 60 days), comedians and venues. Query of 2+ characters.

tools.name: get_show
tools.description: One show by slug, as the schema.org ComedyEvent its public page publishes (date, venue, lineup, offer).

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: One comedy venue (foro) by slug: address, city, zone, links and its upcoming shows.

tools.name: get_comedian
tools.description: One comedian by slug: public profile (schema.org Person) and upcoming shows.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
